plugins.name: agentavow-trust
plugins.description: Signed, verifiable safety grades for the tools your agent connects to. Bundles the AgentAvow MCP connector (scan any MCP server, package, or repo for a signed 0-100 trust score), a /scan command, and an opt-in pre-connect auto-scan hook that grades newly-added MCP servers on session start (warn-only, fail-open).

commands.description: Scan a tool, MCP server, package, or repo with AgentAvow before you trust it
